translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from source extraction and all page images. No acquired prior English translation or translation service used. Selected dictionary checks only; provisional lexical/syntactic readings noted per ID. No independent specialist review.

notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l001: Begins mid-speech: Akbaltay recalls his rescue. No additional opening verse invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l002: Кутман fortunate/auspicious echoes Kutubiy’s name. Same companion is shortened to Kutu on line25.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l006: Iylen and Shiylen are printed champion names; spellings retained without historical identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l008: Bringing the dead soul to life is a rescue metaphor, not literal resurrection here.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l014: Даңгыт denotes large fierce dogs in this threat of dismemberment; not treated as an ethnic name.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l020: Айдарлуу: wearing a forelock. Human attackers understood; exact number unstated.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l021: Айлануу conveys devotional gratitude/self-offering; give thanks is contextual, not literal circling.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l022: Калды сообума provisionally came to my benefit/rescue; religious merit nuance remains.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l024: Садага: affectionate sacrificial devotion, would give his life. Аба elder/uncle is not proof of biological kinship.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l026: Printed жообумду replies retained as being silenced; unusual collocation, raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l035: Түмөн: myriad/ten thousand; here rhetorical contrast with being alone, not an audited troop figure.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l037: Бел wordplay waist/ridge/support; English retains support image rather than literal anatomical assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l042: Милек provisionally countless in parallel with түмөн and ants/grass imagery. Exact rare form requires specialist confirmation.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l043: Compressed divine-will question construed as inability to oppose God; no missing text supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l044: Grass comparison for the massed army retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0400:b001:l047: Кечил: epic Kalmyk sense supported by Yudakhin; not necessarily monastic office here.
notes.manas-2010:p0401:b001:l012: Dyngsha retained as the printed topographical name, without mapping it to a modern location.
notes.manas-2010:p0401:b001:l016: Түтөгөн can smoke/blaze/flourish; blazing anew retains the replenishment metaphor provisionally.
notes.manas-2010:p0401:b001:l021: Narrative explanation of Kakanchyn designation retained; not asserted as historical etymology.
notes.manas-2010:p0401:b001:l025: Dative Бээжинге spans the departure-without-fighting thought; English uses an introductory phrase rather than adding a destination.
notes.manas-2010:p0401:b001:l030: Мурас inheritance/legacy links safety with ancestral homeland; not reduced to material booty.
notes.manas-2010:p0401:b001:l033: Менде read as mortal/пенде, not first-person locative.
notes.manas-2010:p0401:b001:l042: Каркыбар is a praise term for a valiant fellow in Yudakhin/2015 dictionary, not a separate named commander.
notes.manas-2010:p0402:b001:l006: Ала көөдөн: rash/impetuous, not literal variegated chest.
notes.manas-2010:p0402:b001:l012: Printed Айбанат билбей literally beasts not knowing/heeding; relation to warrior deaths is obscure. Tentative literal rendering, not silently changed to айбат.
notes.manas-2010:p0402:b001:l019: Көчүк rump/buttocks; physical loss of seat retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0402:b001:l024: Dark blue-gray war wolves are metaphors for Kyrgyz fighters, not literal wolves here.
notes.manas-2010:p0402:b001:l025: Сында жок provisionally beyond measure/comparison; solitude motif retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0402:b001:l029: Forty hearths denotes households; the number retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0402:b001:l038: Тозолук understood as тосолу, let us block/hold, supported by next rows’ narrow-pass defense. Printed form retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0402:b001:l047: Kichi-Zhyldyz and Chong-Zhyldyz retained as paired place names, literally Lesser/Greater Star; no modern mapping asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0402:b001:l048: Боо provisionally deictic there in the reach-destination construction; compressed form, raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0403:b001:l002: Dog battle describes the proposed harrying/defensive withdrawal. Literal animal metaphor retained; no modern tactical instruction added.
notes.manas-2010:p0403:b001:l004: Аманат life entrusted by God, a recurring devotional formula.
notes.manas-2010:p0403:b001:l009: Mother tying birth cord is ancestral-origin language; not corrected to Manas’s recorded Altay birthplace.
notes.manas-2010:p0403:b001:l017: Speaker changes from Akbaltay to Manas; roar and subsequent exposed teeth belong to Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0403:b001:l019: Gate-sized white teeth is epic bodily exaggeration retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0403:b001:l030: Growing to manhood follows mention of twelve; no age normalization to modern adulthood.
notes.manas-2010:p0403:b001:l045: Кылым эл interpreted all peoples/world, not a century count.
notes.manas-2010:p0404:b001:l004: Макшар is the eschatological gathering/Day of Judgment; tomorrow is future orientation.
notes.manas-2010:p0404:b001:l006: Being ridden as a black donkey is Manas’s feared posthumous humiliation; religious image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0404:b001:l007: Токонаалат provisionally an intensified curse; endless curses communicates force without claiming an exact numeral.
notes.manas-2010:p0404:b001:l024: Өнөк companion/associate; singular retained rather than silently substituting nation.
notes.manas-2010:p0404:b001:l026: Reciprocal head-cutting is a threat to fight to the death; literal violent image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0404:b001:l030: Сары изине чөп салуу is explicitly relentless tracking/persecution in the 2015 phraseological dictionary, which quotes the adjoining саргара кууп formula. Idiom translated semantically, not as physically laying grass.
notes.manas-2010:p0404:b001:l039: Керик rhinoceros as epic mount retained, not rationalized to a horse. Бутун арт- mounting by throwing a leg over.
notes.manas-2010:p0404:b001:l045: The dog/mountain/water/grave rejection sequence continues onto page405; all invocations retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0405:b001:l002: Divine inscription is predestination metaphor, not a specified written document.
notes.manas-2010:p0405:b001:l006: Энеси талак is an abusive maternal/divorce imprecation; mother-cursed preserves its maternal direction without asserting a real divorce.
notes.manas-2010:p0405:b001:l011: Калдай translated governor per context-sensitive shared glossary.
notes.manas-2010:p0405:b001:l012: Кызырдуу blessed/protected by Khizir; name standardized with project usage.
notes.manas-2010:p0405:b001:l016: Чү is an urging cry to a mount; rendered spur his mount, not an uninterpreted utterance.
notes.manas-2010:p0405:b001:l020: Tolgonush retained provisionally as mountain name; could have descriptive winding nuance.
notes.manas-2010:p0405:b001:l027: Printed Бэжин normalized to Beejin in English only; raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0405:b001:l032: Акыйнек: taunting/verbal contest; chant their taunts preserves the performative ridicule.
notes.manas-2010:p0405:b001:l040: Swallowing Baltay is wrath metaphor. Nearly conveys the intensive construction; no killing asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0405:b001:l042: Билектен сап кетүү understood as strength failing. Following heart covering is retained more literally as a fear formula.
notes.manas-2010:p0405:b001:l043: Кап covering/sac of heart retained in fear idiom; not presented as physical cardiac injury.
notes.manas-2010:p0406:b001:l003: Entrusted life repeats аманат; distress concerns impending danger, not a completed death.
notes.manas-2010:p0406:b001:l023: Кечил read as a Kalmyk in the preceding conflict. Monastic sense possible, but not imposed as a specific ecclesiastical rank.
notes.manas-2010:p0406:b001:l025: Кеке throat, not the castration term кая on p417; distinct violent acts retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0406:b001:l028: Ордо is provisionally the knucklebone game in recollection of the earlier episode; literal court/encampment sense would require contextual reevaluation.
notes.manas-2010:p0406:b001:l030: Кара жакка калдайтып compressed: standing grandly in the open is tentative; exact directional meaning uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0406:b001:l031: Ат салышуу can mean competing generally; mounted contests chosen for immediate horse context.
notes.manas-2010:p0406:b001:l032: Sixty days retained; no attempt to reconcile narrated time elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p0406:b001:l035: Кочку is a Kalmyk village headman in Yudakhin. Distinct from элчи messengers on next row; earlier envoy draft corrected.
notes.manas-2010:p0406:b001:l045: Кылымдын эри world’s warrior/mortal soul is compressed self-description; not a numbered century.
notes.manas-2010:p0407:b001:l002: Printed Каканга dative has awkward connection to каптап кетсе. Kakan’s oncoming force understood contextually; raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0407:b001:l013: Unfinished unless clause retained; next sentence renews the vow instead of supplying an invented oath penalty.
notes.manas-2010:p0407:b001:l016: Only death will stop me is contextual rendering of printed Өлбөгөндөн калышам, whose literal negative construction is difficult; provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0407:b001:l023: Five-month interval retained exactly and repeated in lines24/29; no calendar date inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0407:b001:l028: Küzgü city retained as printed place designation; сүзүп interpreted passing through, not literal swimming without water context.
notes.manas-2010:p0407:b001:l032: Saddle-shaped ridge is a landscape comparison, not a specific mapped pass.
notes.manas-2010:p0407:b001:l046: English clauses restored to source row order during paired audit: of the hell-like Kytay / unless I learn their tumult.
notes.manas-2010:p0408:b001:l004: Unborn sinking-away curse expresses self-erasure, not a report of drowning.
notes.manas-2010:p0408:b001:l006: Шай read as holy patrons/saints in protection formula; not a person named Shai.
notes.manas-2010:p0408:b001:l010: Эрин lip; biting through it retained as fury gesture.
notes.manas-2010:p0408:b001:l013: Alone against a thousand is speaker’s rhetorical contrast; does not erase later forty boys and Kutubiy.
notes.manas-2010:p0408:b001:l016: Каңырыгы түтөө grief/distress idiom, literally palate smoking; heart burned conveys affect.
notes.manas-2010:p0408:b001:l021: Printed Алып кетип, кеп сурап is syntactically uncertain; drawing him aside and asking for words is provisional. Not silently changed to алы кетип (strength failed).
notes.manas-2010:p0408:b001:l028: Менде servant/mortal in address to God; recurring form interpreted contextually.
notes.manas-2010:p0408:b001:l033: Айкөл generous/magnanimous one is Manas’s epithet, translated rather than a new name.
notes.manas-2010:p0408:b001:l044: Каралды/караан shelter/support images retained over two separate rows.
notes.manas-2010:p0409:b001:l007: Отор-отор provisionally from camp/pasture to camp with games; exact repeated game expression uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0409:b001:l014: Banner is metaphorical leadership, not becoming a physical flag.
notes.manas-2010:p0409:b001:l019: Отто- dictionaries give grazing/feeding. Grazed upon keeps the disturbing metaphor of gathering the enemy boys; precise action is uncertain. Not expanded into an unsupported massacre or reduced to ordinary play.
notes.manas-2010:p0409:b001:l023: Ордо retained as game term; breaking ordo and taking winnings/booty recall earlier confrontation. Court sense remains possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0409:b001:l035: No saddle retained despite the hero being mounted; rhetorical deprivation not silently repaired to no warrior.
notes.manas-2010:p0409:b001:l037: Жээн nephew through female kin; absence of such a companion retained, not a generic friend substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0409:b001:l044: Only one from his nest is an only-child image; no other genealogy inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0410:b001:l003: Жаманат disgrace/ill repute; addressed in prayer without theological explanation supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0410:b001:l014: Sixty worries retains the source number, an intensifying formula.
notes.manas-2010:p0410:b001:l016: Tulpar epic heroic steed; mouth/head turning means turning the mount.
notes.manas-2010:p0410:b001:l026: Youngest of six lions retained as a heroic group formula; members not supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0410:b001:l029: Forty chiltens are protective spiritual companions; distinct from forty human boys later on page. P416 explicitly gives eighty-four chiltens; discrepancy preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0410:b001:l034: Эри өлгөндөй literally like one whose husband died; widow’s frantic grief comparison retained without normalizing gender.
notes.manas-2010:p0410:b001:l038: Causative/straining chain spans Kutubiy restraining Manas. Manas remains the raging leopard; subject alignment follows context.
notes.manas-2010:p0410:b001:l047: Тумшук promontory/spur here, not a human nose.
notes.manas-2010:p0411:b001:l005: Ezkara is the printed name; not changed to Nezkara/Neskara variants.
notes.manas-2010:p0411:b001:l009: Кара жагал dark mottled description retained; p418 has different black-maned epithet.
notes.manas-2010:p0411:b001:l011: Rhinoceros mount retained despite Döödür’s bay mule in an earlier passage; no animal consistency repair.
notes.manas-2010:p0411:b001:l025: Printed Айбалтай read as battle-axe form, not the character Akbaltay; weapon list determines sense.
notes.manas-2010:p0411:b001:l033: Lexical correction: таш сайынган means a Chinese/Kalmyk official wearing a distinguishing ball/button on the cap, Yudakhin таш I.5 https://el-sozduk.kg/таш/. In this formula таза means finest, not bald/shaven: Yudakhin таза3 https://el-sozduk.kg/ТАЗ/. Raw source unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0411:b001:l040: Roaring golden shield is a close source rendering; no hidden gong introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p0411:b001:l046: Тоту куш conventionally parrot; tail-plume bird identification remains provisional in epic ornament context.
notes.manas-2010:p0412:b001:l012: Chongküröng retained as horse name, literally Great Brown; no separate named rider.
notes.manas-2010:p0412:b001:l016: Көзү ачык open vision expresses seer ability, not merely eyes physically open.
notes.manas-2010:p0412:b001:l024: Widow-grief comparison repeated literally; see p410:l034.
notes.manas-2010:p0412:b001:l031: Nearly fell is contextual intensive reading before speaking; source also permits a completed fall, not independently resolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0412:b001:l033: Өңгөч throat; drawn tight is tentative fear/constriction image, not a medical diagnosis.
notes.manas-2010:p0412:b001:l044: Мээнет affliction/trouble is speaker’s epithet for Manas, not a new personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p0413:b001:l005: Great lord among/above governors is a rank relation, not an established historical promotion.
notes.manas-2010:p0413:b001:l006: Тоорулуп circling/intercepting watch is rendered watched as I passed around; exact movement provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0413:b001:l009: Karykan printed name/title retained without silently identifying him with Esenkan.
notes.manas-2010:p0413:b001:l011: Cutting Chynmachyn’s willows retained literally; exact ceremony or idiomatic military sense uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0413:b001:l020: Unusual negative death formula retained as not yet taken by death; not inverted into an oath to die.
notes.manas-2010:p0413:b001:l025: Көйкашка distinguished/bold champion, not a separate proper name here.
notes.manas-2010:p0413:b001:l037: Eighteen thousand worlds is cosmological imagery; not geographic inventory.
notes.manas-2010:p0413:b001:l038: Даты келер provisionally strength/capacity to match; compressed epic usage.
notes.manas-2010:p0413:b001:l047: Approval of killing sorcerers belongs to Ezkara’s speech, not translator judgment.
notes.manas-2010:p0414:b001:l005: Далдалы provisionally shoulder blades/back in pulverizing image; exact rare form uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0414:b001:l012: Interior wider than earth is a seer’s hyperbolic description; not literal anatomy.
notes.manas-2010:p0414:b001:l023: Ат бороюн сыдырдым provisionally wore down the horse’s hide through travel; exact collocation requires specialist review.
notes.manas-2010:p0414:b001:l024: Bangbang-Sazangshang retained as printed epic place sequence; not geolocated.
notes.manas-2010:p0414:b001:l034: With the seers is printed construction; not replaced with as a seer.
notes.manas-2010:p0414:b001:l038: Different father/lineage retained literally; no genealogy invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0414:b001:l045: Same fear formula as p405: strength failing in forearms, heart covering falling.
notes.manas-2010:p0414:b001:l048: Бушман distress, dictionary-supported; p415:l002 душман enemy creates rhyme/contrast, kept distinct.
notes.manas-2010:p0415:b001:l008: Oyrat retained as epic ethnonym; not broadened to all humankind.
notes.manas-2010:p0415:b001:l017: Gray tiger comparison of Manas followed by distinct leopard at his side and lion. Source alternates heroic likeness and guardian figures.
notes.manas-2010:p0415:b001:l022: Чолок literally shortened/maimed; short-tailed selected from guardian-lion formula, not certainty about anatomy.
notes.manas-2010:p0415:b001:l030: Printed жыткан interpreted as intended жаткан in recurring кайнап жаткан (seething) formula. Raw unchanged; dictionary smell sense would disrupt formula.
notes.manas-2010:p0415:b001:l032: Өңү саз fine/handsome face, contextual reading of саз rather than marsh.
notes.manas-2010:p0415:b001:l037: Printed өрттөнбөй retained as burning; reflexive/transitive ambiguity not silently emended to өрттөбөй.
notes.manas-2010:p0416:b001:l007: Бил мүчөлүү exactly elephant-framed in Yudakhin; бил is elephant, not know or waist.
notes.manas-2010:p0416:b001:l011: Колтук ачпоо literally not opening armpit, contextual guard/resistance image.
notes.manas-2010:p0416:b001:l017: Буткул сеңир massive crag, provisional adjective; physical nose comparison retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0416:b001:l021: Ezkara invokes Khizir’s blessing for his own side; religious mixture preserved, not corrected.
notes.manas-2010:p0416:b001:l026: Буркум understood as contracted/variant possessive буркан, idol/divinity. My idol is provisional; printed form retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0416:b001:l037: Укурук horse-catching pole; not one left to wield it is annihilation imagery, not a literal pole-turning procedure.
notes.manas-2010:p0416:b001:l038: Source explicitly says eighty-four chiltens, unlike forty on p410. Count preserved. It offers a possible internal parallel to p348’s eighty-four equipped/armament formula but does not justify replacing that earlier text.
notes.manas-2010:p0417:b001:l003: Six swift horses and palm-sized letter retained; messengers are implicit, not six invented named riders.
notes.manas-2010:p0417:b001:l029: Source changes person/implicit subject amid recalling attack and counterattack. Neutral fierce wrath broke out avoids assigning the third-person verb unambiguously to we.
notes.manas-2010:p0417:b001:l033: Кечил epic Kalmyk sense; individual captive in line35 is not automatically identified with a named earlier captive.
notes.manas-2010:p0417:b001:l038: Кая testicles: castration explicitly described; not euphemized as generic injury.
notes.manas-2010:p0417:b001:l039: Threefold turmoil preserves the numeral; three distinct episodes not invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0417:b001:l041: Үкүр is cattle in Yudakhin’s Kalmyk-dialogue epic usage, with a closely matching horses/cattle raiding formula. Corrected from generic whole herd.
notes.manas-2010:p0418:b001:l005: Коржойтуп cause to crouch/shrink, an intended humiliation/defeat image; exact posture provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0418:b001:l018: Oath subject understood as commanders/troops following receiving orders; syntax also permits Esenkan, so attribution remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0418:b001:l029: Footmen too heavy for horses is bodily exaggeration; no unit size inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0418:b001:l032: Кынжы collar/chain, dictionary-supported from p353 check; not waist belt.
notes.manas-2010:p0418:b001:l040: Чоюнбаш clearly the striking iron-headed mace in this weapon construction, not a proper name.
notes.manas-2010:p0418:b001:l041: One thousand for Boroonchu retained; not combined into a verified total army size.
notes.manas-2010:p0419:b001:l005: Drinks poison when told water is a fearlessness/recklessness image, not advice or a poisoning procedure.
notes.manas-2010:p0419:b001:l017: Бил elephant, dictionary-supported; rhinoceros and elephant mounts retained as epic narration.
notes.manas-2010:p0419:b001:l018: Каркыбар valiant/mighty fellows, a praise term rather than a new named group.
notes.manas-2010:p0419:b001:l023: Чогоол forceful/fierce gun; no specific firearm model inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0419:b001:l038: Half a mountain is literal source magnitude; not human measurement.

transcription_check.scope: All twenty PDF pages rendered at 1600 pixels and visually inspected in five groups of four. Each page contains 48 body verse rows in b001; no headings, prose or watermark rows. Raw source unchanged. Digital witness check only, not manuscript collation.

alignment_check.method: All 960 Kyrgyz/English pairs read after drafting in four five-page groups; first24rows reread separately after tool truncation. Explicit ordered IDs and page counts verified. Reversed pair407:l046–047 restored; cattle/headman/tracking idiom corrected from dictionary evidence.
